name: stridecal-lambda-app
description: Stridecal Investment Analysis - AWS Lambda Deployment

scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run prepare:lambda
scripts.prepare:lambda: cp -r dist/* lambda/ || echo 'No dist directory found'
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run build && serverless deploy --stage dev
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run build && serverless deploy --stage prod
